faq.title: Return Policy
faq.answer: At Northstar Demo Store, unused items in their original packaging can be requested for return within 30 days of delivery. Final-sale items are excluded. Keep your order number and proof of purchase ready. These are fictional demo rules; a support reviewer confirms eligibility.
